## SVM Model
```{r}
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(knitr)

# Read dataset
ufc_model <- readRDS("ufc_model.rds")

# Keep only the columns we need and remove NAs
ufc_clean <- na.omit(ufc_model[, c("Winner", "R_age", "B_age", "R_Height_cms", "B_Height_cms","R_Reach_cms", "B_Reach_cms", "R_avg_SIG_STR_landed", "B_avg_SIG_STR_landed", "R_avg_TD_landed", "B_avg_TD_landed", "R_avg_SUB_ATT", "B_avg_SUB_ATT", "R_wins", "B_wins", "R_odds", "B_odds", "r_dec_odds", "b_dec_odds", "r_sub_odds", "b_sub_odds", "r_ko_odds", "b_ko_odds", "B_current_lose_streak", "B_current_win_streak", "R_current_lose_streak", "R_current_win_streak", "R_longest_win_streak", "B_longest_win_streak")])

# Normalize predictors (0 to 1)
normalize <- function(x) {
  return((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

ufc_norm <- as.data.frame(lapply(ufc_clean[, -1], normalize))
ufc_norm$Winner <- ifelse(ufc_clean$Winner == "Red", 1, 0)

# Split the dataset
ratio <- 0.7
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(ufc_norm), ratio * nrow(ufc_norm))
ufc_train <- ufc_norm[train_rows, ]
ufc_test  <- ufc_norm[-train_rows, ]
```


```{r}
#ufc_test <- as.factor(ufc_test)
#ufc_train <- as.factor(ufc_train)

library(kernlab)
svm.model <- ksvm(Winner ~ ., data = ufc_train, kernel = "vanilladot")
svm.model
```


```{r}
svm.pred <- predict(svm.model, ufc_test)

library(caret)
#confusionMatrix(svm.pred, ufc_test$Winner, positive = "1")
```
